correctness.rationale: For the rearrangement-invariant Lorentz plane, signed permutations make the optimal Euclidean pullback circular. On the Euclidean unit circle in the first octant, F(s)=(1+omega s^q)^(1/q)/sqrt(1+s^2), and F'/F has the sign of s(omega s^(q-2)-1). For 1<q<2 this gives the unique interior maximum s_*=omega^(1/(2-q)). The endpoint minimum switches exactly when (1+omega)^(1/q)/sqrt(2)=1, i.e. omega=2^(q/2)-1, yielding the two stated branches. Boundary agreement is exact.
